label: Malagawatch Point eastern shoreline extremum
point_definition: eastern extremum of the mapped headland
identity_evidence: The peninsula approaches from the west and curves around its eastern face into a long northwestern hook, with the enclosed cove, detached islets to the northwest and the southern harbour shore in the same sequence. The eastern outer-coast extremum is clear away from the label. The interior ponds and finer modern shoreline details are not substituted for the outer coast.
phase: Fresh independent validation of frozen TPS13; excluded from fitting and selection
